title.ja: モーショングラフィックスの動き
カメラワークと切り替え

categories.ja: 切り替え（トランジション）
選ぶ・切り替えるパーツ
案内する・状態を伝えるパーツ
スクロールで起きる演出
マウス・クリックへの反応
読み込み・移動・動き続ける演出

title.ja: 写真の表現・光と画風

categories.ja: レンズ・カメラの効果

meaning.ja: ポンと弾んで現れる
meaning.en: Pops into view with a small bounce

meaning.ja: 少しずつ時間をずらして順に出す
meaning.en: Items appear one after another, slightly offset in time

meaning.ja: 登場に合わせて線や粒が弾ける
meaning.en: Lines and dots burst outward as something appears

meaning.ja: 線が描かれるように伸びる
meaning.en: A line extends as if it were being drawn

meaning.ja: 見えない枠の中から文字がせり上がる
meaning.en: Text rises into view from behind an invisible edge

meaning.ja: 1文字ずつ打たれるように出る
meaning.en: Text appears one character at a time, as if typed

meaning.ja: 数字が勢いよく増えていく
meaning.en: A number runs up quickly to its final value

name.ja: キネティックタイポグラフィ

meaning.ja: 言葉に合わせて文字が動き回る
meaning.en: Words move, scale and turn in time with what is said

meaning.ja: 緩急をつけて気持ちよく動かす
meaning.en: Motion speeds up and slows down instead of moving at one speed

meaning.ja: 行き過ぎてから戻って止まる
meaning.en: Goes a little past the target, then settles back

name.ja: スクワッシュ＆ストレッチ

meaning.ja: つぶれて伸びて弾力を出す
meaning.en: Squashes and stretches so that it feels elastic

meaning.ja: 形が別の形に変わる
meaning.en: One shape turns smoothly into another

meaning.ja: 液体のようにぬるっと動く
meaning.en: Shapes move and merge like liquid

meaning.ja: 動いた跡に残像が尾を引く
meaning.en: A fading trail follows a moving object

meaning.ja: 粒が飛び散る
meaning.en: Many small pieces fly out and scatter

meaning.ja: 手前と奥をずらして動かし奥行きを出す
meaning.en: Near and far layers move at different speeds to show depth

name.ja: マスクトランジション

meaning.ja: 形の中から次の画面が現れる
meaning.en: The next scene appears inside a growing shape

name.ja: シェイプトランジション

meaning.ja: 図形が画面を覆って切り替わる
meaning.en: Shapes cover the screen and uncover the next scene

name.ja: リキッドトランジション

meaning.ja: 液体が流れ込んで切り替わる
meaning.en: Liquid flows in and replaces the scene

meaning.ja: 物の中へ突き抜けて次へ
meaning.en: Zooms into an object and passes through it into the next scene

meaning.ja: カードのように裏返る
meaning.en: Turns over like a card to show the other side

meaning.ja: 光が表面を横切る
meaning.en: A band of light crosses a surface

meaning.ja: 映像がバグったように乱れる
meaning.en: The picture breaks up as if it were malfunctioning

meaning.ja: 着地の衝撃で画面が揺れる
meaning.en: The whole frame shakes when something lands

meaning.ja: カメラを横に振る
meaning.en: Pivot the camera left or right

meaning.ja: カメラを縦に振る
meaning.en: Pivot the camera up or down

meaning.ja: カメラごと被写体に近づく
meaning.en: Move the camera toward the subject

meaning.ja: レンズで寄る（位置は動かない）
meaning.en: Magnify with the lens (camera stays put)

meaning.ja: 被写体と並んで動く
meaning.en: Move along with the subject

meaning.ja: 被写体の周りを回り込む
meaning.en: Circle around the subject

meaning.ja: カメラが上へ昇っていく
meaning.en: Lift the camera up

meaning.ja: 人物はそのまま背景だけ伸び縮み
meaning.en: Subject stays, background warps

meaning.ja: ピントを手前と奥のあいだで送る
meaning.en: Shift focus between near and far

meaning.ja: 手で持って撮ったように小さく揺らす（ハンドヘルド）
meaning.en: A slight shake, as if the camera were held by hand

meaning.ja: ドローンで突き進む疾走感
meaning.en: Fast, immersive fly-through

meaning.ja: 画面を斜めに傾ける
meaning.en: Tilt the frame diagonally

meaning.ja: 動きをゆっくり見せる
meaning.en: Play the action slower

meaning.ja: 速い→遅いと速さを変える
meaning.en: Change speed mid-shot

meaning.ja: 長い時間を早送りで見せる
meaning.en: Compress hours into seconds

meaning.ja: 動きを一瞬止める
meaning.en: Pause the action for a beat

meaning.ja: 同じ画角のまま時間を飛ばす
meaning.en: Same framing, skip ahead in time

meaning.ja: 形や動きをそろえて場面を変える
meaning.en: Cut on a matching shape or motion

meaning.ja: 素早く振ってブレで次へ
meaning.en: Fast pan blur into the next shot

meaning.ja: 前後の映像を重ねて溶かす
meaning.en: Blend one shot into the next

meaning.ja: 境目が横切って画面が入れ替わる
meaning.en: A moving edge replaces the shot

meaning.ja: 対照的な場面へ前触れなく切り替える
meaning.en: Abrupt cut to a contrasting scene

meaning.ja: 次の場面の音が先に聞こえる
meaning.en: Next scene's audio starts first

meaning.ja: 前の場面の音が後まで残る
meaning.en: Previous scene's audio carries over

meaning.ja: 画面を暗くして中央に窓が出る
meaning.en: A window opens in the middle while the page behind dims

meaning.ja: 横からメニューが引き出される
meaning.en: A menu panel slides in from the side of the screen

meaning.ja: 下からパネルがせり上がる
meaning.en: A panel slides up from the bottom of the screen

meaning.ja: 押すと中身が開閉する
meaning.en: Click a heading to show or hide its content

meaning.ja: 押すと選択肢が下に広がる
meaning.en: Click a field to drop a list of options below it

meaning.ja: 乗せると小さな説明が出る
meaning.en: Hover over something to show a short label

meaning.ja: 押すと吹き出しの小窓が出る
meaning.en: Click a button to open a small panel pointing at it

meaning.ja: 隅に通知が出て自動で消える
meaning.en: A short message appears in a corner and goes away on its own

meaning.ja: 見出しを押して中身を切り替える
meaning.en: Click a label to switch which panel is shown

meaning.ja: 横に送って順番に見せる
meaning.en: Slides that move sideways to show one item at a time

meaning.ja: オン・オフを切り替える
meaning.en: Flip a setting on or off

name.ja: セグメントコントロール

meaning.ja: 並んだボタンで表示を切り替える
meaning.en: A row of joined buttons that switches the view

meaning.ja: 押して絞り込み条件を付け外し
meaning.en: Small pills you click to add or remove a filter

meaning.ja: つまみ2つで範囲を選ぶ
meaning.en: Two handles on one track pick a minimum and a maximum

meaning.ja: ＋/−ボタンで数を増減する
meaning.en: Plus and minus buttons that change a number by one

meaning.ja: 番号でページを送る
meaning.en: Numbered buttons that move between pages

name.ja: ハンバーガーメニュー

meaning.ja: 三本線を押すとメニューが開く
meaning.en: A three-line icon that opens the menu

meaning.ja: 今いる場所を階層で示す
meaning.en: A trail of links showing where the page sits in the site

meaning.ja: 大きな一覧メニューが広がる
meaning.en: A wide panel of grouped links that opens from the main menu

name.ja: ステップインジケーター

meaning.ja: 手続きの何番目かを示す
meaning.en: Shows which step of a process you are on

meaning.ja: 読み込み中に灰色の枠を出す
meaning.en: Grey shapes stand in for content while it loads

meaning.ja: くるくる回って待ちを示す
meaning.en: A spinning circle that means "please wait"

meaning.ja: 件数を小さな丸で示す
meaning.en: A small dot with a number showing a count

meaning.ja: 中身がないときの案内画面
meaning.en: The screen shown when there is nothing to list yet

name.ja: パララックススクロール

meaning.ja: スクロールで奥の層ほどゆっくり動く
meaning.en: On scroll, background layers move slower than the content

name.ja: スクロールでフェードイン

meaning.ja: 画面に入った要素がふわっと現れる
meaning.en: Elements fade in as they scroll into view

meaning.ja: スクロールしてもヘッダーが上に残る
meaning.en: The header stays at the top while the page scrolls

meaning.ja: セクションを止めて中身だけ進める
meaning.en: A section stays fixed while scrolling advances its content

meaning.ja: 縦のスクロールで中身が横に流れる
meaning.en: Scrolling down moves the content sideways

meaning.ja: スクロールが区切りの位置にピタッと止まる
meaning.en: Scrolling settles exactly on the next section

name.ja: スクロールプログレスバー

meaning.ja: 読み進めた割合を上の線で見せる
meaning.en: A bar at the top shows how far you have read

name.ja: マーカーアニメーション

meaning.ja: 大事な言葉に蛍光ペンの線が引かれる
meaning.en: A highlighter stroke is drawn under key words

meaning.ja: カーソルを乗せると影を付けて浮く
meaning.en: On hover, the element rises with a deeper shadow

meaning.ja: 枠はそのままで写真だけ拡大する
meaning.en: The photo enlarges inside a fixed frame

meaning.ja: カーソルを丸が遅れて追いかける
meaning.en: A shape trails the mouse pointer with a delay

name.ja: マグネティックボタン

meaning.ja: 近づいたカーソルにボタンが吸い寄せられる
meaning.en: The button is pulled toward a nearby cursor

meaning.ja: 押した場所から波紋が広がる
meaning.en: A ripple spreads from the point that was pressed

meaning.ja: 乗せたリンクの下線が左から伸びる
meaning.en: A link's underline grows from the left on hover

name.ja: ビフォーアフタースライダー

meaning.ja: 境目をドラッグして前と後を見比べる
meaning.en: Drag a divider to compare before and after

name.ja: 離脱防止ポップアップ

meaning.ja: ページを離れそうな時に出す引き止めの小窓
meaning.en: A popup shown when the visitor is about to leave

meaning.ja: 読み込み中に出す画面
meaning.en: A screen shown while the page loads

meaning.ja: 画面に入った画像だけを読み込む
meaning.en: Images load only when they come into view

meaning.ja: 下まで来ると続きが自動で足される
meaning.en: More items load automatically at the bottom

name.ja: ページ遷移アニメーション

meaning.ja: ページを移るときの切り替えの演出
meaning.en: An animation that bridges two pages

meaning.ja: ページ内リンクでなめらかに移動する
meaning.en: In-page links glide to their target instead of jumping

meaning.ja: 文字や画像が帯で流れ続ける
meaning.en: Text or logos scroll across in an endless band

name.ja: グラデーションアニメーション

meaning.ja: 背景の色の混ざり方が動き続ける
meaning.en: Background colours keep drifting and blending

name.ja: ふわふわアニメーション

meaning.ja: 飾りがゆっくり上下に浮き沈みする
meaning.en: Elements bob gently up and down

meaning.ja: 被写体の真後ろから光を当てる
meaning.en: The light source sits behind the subject

meaning.ja: 後ろからの光で輪郭だけを光らせる
meaning.en: A light from behind that outlines the subject's edge

meaning.ja: 明るい空を背に、被写体を黒い形だけで見せる
meaning.en: The subject shows as a black shape against a bright sky

name.ja: スプリットライティング

meaning.ja: 真横からの光で顔を半分ずつ明暗に分ける
meaning.en: Light from the side splits the face into lit and dark halves

name.ja: レンブラントライティング

meaning.ja: 影側の頬に三角形の光が残る斜め上からの光
meaning.en: High side light that leaves a lit triangle on the shadow cheek

name.ja: バタフライライティング

meaning.ja: 正面の高い位置から当て、鼻の下に蝶形の影
meaning.en: High frontal light that casts a butterfly shadow under the nose

meaning.ja: 日没前・日の出後の低く赤みのある光
meaning.en: The low, warm light just after sunrise or before sunset

meaning.ja: 日没後・日の出前の、空が深い青になる時間
meaning.en: The time after sunset or before sunrise when the sky turns deep blue

meaning.ja: ピントの外の点光源が丸くやわらかくぼける
meaning.en: Out-of-focus points of light melt into soft discs

meaning.ja: 上下をぼかして本物の町を模型のように見せる
meaning.en: Blur top and bottom so a real scene looks like a miniature

meaning.ja: シャッターを長く開け、動く光を線にする
meaning.en: Keep the shutter open long so moving lights become lines

meaning.ja: 動く被写体を追って撮り、背景だけ流す
meaning.en: Follow a moving subject so only the background streaks

meaning.ja: 強い光でレンズの中に光の輪や玉が出る
meaning.en: Rings and spots of light from a bright source in the lens

meaning.ja: 中心がふくらみ、直線が丸く曲がる超広角
meaning.en: Ultra-wide lens that bulges the centre and bends straight lines

meaning.ja: 明暗の境に赤や青紫の色ずれが出る
meaning.en: Red and blue-violet colour fringes along high-contrast edges

meaning.ja: 画面の四隅が暗くなり、中央に目が集まる
meaning.en: The corners darken and draw the eye to the centre

meaning.ja: 明るい色だけで作る、白っぽく影の薄い写真
meaning.en: A bright, white-toned image with very light shadows

meaning.ja: 暗い色が中心の、光の当たる所だけが浮かぶ写真
meaning.en: A dark image where only the lit parts stand out

meaning.ja: 色を抜いて明るさだけで見せる
meaning.en: Remove colour and show brightness only

meaning.ja: 暗部と明部を2色だけで表す
meaning.en: Show the image in two colours, one for darks and one for lights

meaning.ja: 影を青緑、肌や明部を橙に寄せる色調
meaning.en: Pushes shadows to teal and skin and highlights to orange

meaning.ja: フィルム写真のような細かい粒子を乗せる
meaning.en: Fine, film-like grain over the image

meaning.ja: フィルムに光がもれたような赤橙のにじみ
meaning.en: Red-orange glow as if light leaked onto the film

meaning.ja: 2枚の写真を1枚に重ねて写し込む
meaning.en: Two photos layered into one frame
